label: Turret 9b (full CAD)
describe: Layout 9b, every part of the code-CAD (sim/mechanism/turret/cad.py). Hood and extension held rigidly at the servo command; the lift wheel is a free pivot under gravity that rests on a catch 3 mm above a seated NECTAR, drops onto the ball when the catch retracts and is caught again as it falls back. The robot (cell, U, lift) is at a random angle under the turret each shot.

label: Turret 9b (contact parts only)
describe: Layout 9b with ONLY the parts that touch the ball, floating in place: lift wheel, cell pockets, bore U + ring, hood + extension, flywheel. Same physics and controls as the full 9b.

label: Lightsaders v2 turret + lift feed (v12b)
describe: The v2 robot's turret on its feed: the ball sits in the carousel cell's bowl, the servo crank swings the lift arm in and the 2 in rubber lift wheel rolls it up the Cat Tongue spine into the sprung throat wheel and the flywheel (shooter/v10.py V10Bench on designs/v12b.yaml). Drawn from the v2 code-CAD. No calibration yet: DIRECT mode (wheel rpm and hood angle).

label: v9: sliding round hood + rolling extension
describe: Fixed trough hood slides level for NECTAR on a dead-centre crank; an extension rolls up the same circle for flatter shots; the ball is lifted from the carousel cell and caught by two sprung side wheels geared to the flywheel, then rides a fixed front ramp into the pinch. Everything sits on the ring gear.

label: Team turret draft (spring loaded)
describe: The team's first draft, read from its STEP: fixed exit angle (~56 deg), sprung hood on slotted carriers. Spring, motor drive and hood rest position are ESTIMATES.
